verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a public RESTful API at api.rollbar.com, with reference pages for endpoints such as listing items with filters and pagination, plus a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Item, Occurrence, Metrics and Deploy resources. Access-token management is also documented, so a programmatic agent can authenticate and drive the product. The probe's 404s on standard OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is published at a different documented URL. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that write and management actions (e.g. resolving or assigning items) are available via the API rather than just 'much of the data', and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
